page.layout: Three columns of index entries under the running head "INDEX X.", with leading chapter numbers at the left of each line and page references at the right. Column 1 holds the Gospel entries and the headings ACTORVM. and AD ROMANOS. Column 2 continues from column 1 and holds the Romans entries. Column 3 continues from column 2 and holds the Corinthians entries, with the heading I. AD CORINTH. No page number is printed. A catchword sits at the foot right of column 3.

page.notes: Column 1 ends "Quid si quidam eorum non cre-", continued at the top of column 2 as "diderunt". Column 2 ends "Qui diligit proximū,legem im-", continued at the top of column 3 as "pleuit". Both are one line each, marked as continuations. Doubtful readings: the leading number "23" of "Sum Pharisaeus" and the Greek-looking forms "noiat°" and "fue rit auar°" in I Cor. 5 are uncertain; the page numbers and the word "se-ipsis" in AD ROMANOS are uncertain. The "10" before the catchword "Vnum" is printed as a line number and could belong to the catchword line. No page number is printed. The running head is taken from the printed title "INDEX X.".
